title: QoS rejection toast is gated on a selection, but the right-click dial path never selects — a rejected dial cycle with no selected pipe is silent
detail: cycle_emphasis's rejection branch sets last_reject, but the toast renders only inside `if app.sel_pipe >= 0`, and right-click never sets sel_pipe. A rejected dial move on an unselected pipe contradicts the app's own "must never be silent" invariant. Latent today (shipped roster has no max_loss_pct==0 class; E6 rejections need never-drop content), live the moment it exists.
recommended_fix: Move the toast block outside the `if app.sel_pipe >= 0` gate (draw it whenever last_reject is fresh), or have the right-click handler set app.sel_pipe before cycling.

title: Demo parse-error paths leak the new emphasis/lanes arrays (early return before the deletes)
detail: parse_demo allocates emphasis/lanes on context.allocator, then any error return drops them; run_demo and load_demo_replay both return before the delete/defer lines. Two small slices on a fatal demo-authoring path — same pre-existing pattern as the sibling arrays (draws/spawns/demolishes/captures), extended to the 3.2 arrays.
recommended_fix: Move the demo cleanup (or at least delete(demo.emphasis)/delete(demo.lanes)) before the parse-error early returns, or have parse_demo free its own arrays on error.
